candidates: OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable definition in the IaC template for ThumbnailerFunction
answer.explanation: Every ThumbnailerFunction invocation in the window fails at S3.put_object with NoSuchBucket ('The specified bucket does not exist'), while the other functions (CrudApi, Uploader, Compression) complete normally. NoSuchBucket means the target bucket name does not exist, which points to a wrong bucket name in the live OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable. An IAM permission problem would surface as AccessDenied, not NoSuchBucket, so IAM is unlikely. The IaC template is listed as a candidate because the wrong name may have been introduced there and propagated. No tools were available to verify the live value, so this is inferred from the logs alone.
